# -h shows the usage and the path of the configuration file, and exits 0.
exec rexdiff -h
stderr '^usage: rexdiff \[flags\] \[repo\]'
stderr '-layout value'
stderr 'config: '$WORK'/.config/rexdiff/config.toml'
! stdout .

# XDG_CONFIG_HOME and REXDIFF_CONFIG move the configuration file.
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg
exec rexdiff -h
stderr 'config: '$WORK'/xdg/rexdiff/config.toml'
env REXDIFF_CONFIG=$WORK/my.toml
exec rexdiff -h
stderr 'config: '$WORK'/my.toml'

# install -h shows the flags of install and writes nothing.
exec rexdiff install -h
stderr '-placement string'
! exists .config/rex
